title: TermAl's persistence writer did not acknowledge a named-root authority PersistFence within the 20 s admission deadline, so a Begin was withheld before sending
outcome: The time TermAl's persist writer takes to acknowledge an EngramWorkAuthority PersistFence is understood from recorded evidence. A fence that misses its deadline names its phase and whether the authority image is still owned, and a superseded fence resolves promptly without spending the admission budget. Reserving Begin's share of the budget is the child w-aef183670c4e.
acceptance: The holder's note traces, with file:line, the path from the guard before Begin (engram_host_adapter.rs:5179-5186) through prepare_engram_authority_until's fences (engram_root_authority.rs:1321-1381, :1454-1515), the persist writer tick (app_boot.rs:540-671; state_inner.rs:1040-1132; persist.rs:1383-1496) and fence acknowledgement (persist_fence.rs:418-491). It states that today's records cannot name the slow phase, and what the new timing records.

F1: the persist writer keeps bounded per-tick phase timings (collect, serialize, writer-ticket wait, commit including checkpoint, acknowledgement). A fence that misses its deadline yields a holder-visible cause naming its phase (queued, awaiting tick, in tick, or written but unmatched) and whether the authority image is still owned, with remote not_started. A fail-first test with a gated writer and scripted clock (no load) shows the generic 'persistence is unconfirmed (Deadline)' on unchanged code and the phase-naming cause after.

F2: a fence whose authority image has been superseded resolves promptly as Superseded, without spending the remaining admission budget. A fail-first test shows Deadline after the full budget on unchanged code and a prompt Superseded after.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary:
F1+F2 for the persist fence deadline that withheld a Begin.
- The persist writer records per-tick phase timings (collect, serialize, open, writer ticket, statements, commit including any WAL checkpoint, post-commit, acknowledgement), including a failed phase's time, and logs ticks of 1 s or more.
- A named-root authority fence that misses its deadline names its phase and whether its image is still current, without waiting for the state lock.
- A fence whose image a later owner replaced resolves at once as superseded.
Evidence:
- Fail-first: RED test-f886774a on unchanged code, then GREEN.
- Review pair round 3 clean (Codex 36b24d1b, Claude a4c2061d).
- Full gate test-9214c233 (record 09b6c413) passed on exactly the committed tree.
- Evaluation 4b8d1403, 4/4.
